name: Classic Jerk
description: Tells you the weather. Hates you a little.

storm.head: It's a fucking thunderstorm.
storm.sub: The sky is throwing a tantrum. Unplug your shit and stay in.

storm.head: Lightning. Go inside, genius.
storm.sub: You're not in a movie. Nobody needs to see you stand in a field.

storm.head: Thor is pissed.
storm.sub: Whatever you did, apologize. Then stay the hell indoors.

storm.head: The sky is screaming.
storm.sub: Honestly, same. Stay in and keep your phone charged.

storm.head: Nature's having a meltdown.
storm.sub: Thunder, lightning, the works. Stay inside and pretend you're in a cozy movie.

storm.head: Kaboom. Stay the hell in.
storm.sub: Lightning hits the tallest thing around. Don't be the tallest thing around.

storm.head: It's biblical out there.
storm.sub: Charge your phone, find a flashlight, and cancel whatever dumb plan you had.

storm.head: Zeus is throwing shit again.
storm.sub: Don't golf. Don't hike. Don't stand under a tree like an idiot.

storm.head: The sky is clearing its throat. Loudly.
storm.sub: Thunder at {temp}. Your dog is under the bed and honestly, join him.

storm.head: Absolutely not.
storm.sub: Storms all over {city}. Whatever it is, it can wait. Stay in.

storm.head: Power outage speedrun.
storm.sub: Find the candles now, not in the dark while swearing.

storm.head: Lightning roulette.
storm.sub: Every flash is the sky picking a target. Don't volunteer.

storm.head: The sky is drunk and angry.
storm.sub: Stay inside until it sobers up.

snow.head: It's fucking snowing.
snow.sub: Pretty for about four minutes, then it turns into gray slush.

snow.head: Snow. Great. Fantastic.
snow.sub: Drive like your grandma is watching. Because she is.

snow.head: The sky is dandruffing.
snow.sub: Boots on. And no, sneakers do not count as boots.

snow.head: Winter wonderland my ass.
snow.sub: It's frozen water falling on you. Dress like you mean it.

snow.head: Holy shit, snow.
snow.sub: Everything's white and quiet. Enjoy it before the plows turn it brown.

snow.head: Snow day? Not for you, adult.
snow.sub: You still have to work. The snow doesn't care. Neither does your boss.

snow.head: Cold, wet and sideways.
snow.sub: {temp} and snowing. Layer up like a damn onion.

snow.head: Shovel time, champ.
snow.sub: Lift with your legs. Your back has had enough of your bullshit.

snow.head: Slip-and-slide season.
snow.sub: Walk like a penguin. It's not cute, it's physics.

snow.head: Frozen fluff from hell.
snow.sub: Looks magical. Gets in your socks. Real boots, now.

snow.head: The world got a white-out.
snow.sub: Drive like there's an egg under your gas pedal. Because there basically is.

snow.head: Snowmageddon, junior edition.
snow.sub: {temp} and piling up. The bread and milk aisles are already a warzone.

snow.head: Everything's slippery as shit.
snow.sub: Stairs, sidewalks, your dignity. Hold the railing.

rain.head: It's fucking raining.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance you regret leaving that umbrella at home.

rain.head: Wet. Everything is wet.
rain.sub: Socks included, if you go out like an idiot.

rain.head: The sky is crying again.
rain.sub: Not about you. Probably. Bring a damn umbrella.

rain.head: Rain. Obviously.
rain.sub: Your hair is about to have a really bad day.

rain.head: Soggy as shit.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance and the sky is cashing every percent of it.

rain.head: Grab the damn umbrella.
rain.sub: Not the tiny broken one. The real one.

rain.head: Rain, rain, fuck off.
rain.sub: Come again some other day. Ideally never. Bring a hood.

rain.head: Puddle season.
rain.sub: Every puddle is deeper than it looks. You will learn this the hard way.

rain.head: Wet dog weather.
rain.sub: Everything smells like wet dog. Including people who don't own dogs.

rain.head: Indoors. Blanket. Done.
rain.sub: Rain at {temp}. Perfect excuse to do nothing. You're welcome.

rain.head: Your shoes are about to die.
rain.sub: Canvas sneakers in this? Bold. Stupid, but bold.

rain.head: Monsoon mode.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance. Your umbrella is about to earn its keep.

rain.head: Wet. Again. Fuck.
rain.sub: The sky has a leak and nobody's coming to fix it.

drizzle.head: It's drizzling. Ugh.
drizzle.sub: Too weak for an umbrella, strong enough to ruin your glasses.

drizzle.head: Spitting rain.
drizzle.sub: The sky is too lazy to commit to actually raining. Relatable.

drizzle.head: Mist with an attitude.
drizzle.sub: Not quite rain. Still somehow fucks up your hair.

drizzle.head: Rain's lazy cousin.
drizzle.sub: Barely wet, deeply annoying. Hood up.

drizzle.head: Is it raining? Kinda?
drizzle.sub: Yes. Sort of. Enough to fuck up your glasses.

drizzle.head: Damp. Just damp.
drizzle.sub: Not worth an umbrella, but you'll regret not bringing one.

drizzle.head: Spray-bottle weather.
drizzle.sub: Like the sky is a cat owner and you're the cat on the counter.

drizzle.head: Wet-ish. Ugh.
drizzle.sub: The kind of rain that ruins your hair but doesn't count as an excuse to stay home.

drizzle.head: The sky is sneezing on you.
drizzle.sub: Gross, light and constant. Hood up.

drizzle.head: Fine mist of disappointment.
drizzle.sub: Too wet for suede, too dry to stay home. Ugh.

drizzle.head: Drip, drip, damn it.
drizzle.sub: Wipers on intermittent. Mood on intermittent too.

fog.head: Can't see shit.
fog.sub: It's foggy as hell. Headlights on, ego off.

fog.head: Silent Hill vibes.
fog.sub: Visibility is about {vis}. Drive slow, and maybe skip the creepy alley.

fog.head: The world forgot to load.
fog.sub: Fog everywhere. Don't walk into anything expensive.

fog.head: Where the hell did everything go?
fog.sub: The fog ate {city}. Drive slow and pray.

fog.head: Pea soup out there.
fog.sub: Visibility is {vis}. That's not a lot of seeing.

fog.head: Spooky as shit.
fog.sub: Perfect day to hear footsteps behind you. Don't turn around.

fog.head: Cloud? On the ground? Rude.
fog.sub: Low beams, not high beams. High beams just make it worse, genius.

fog.head: Fog. Thick as hell.
fog.sub: Can't see the end of the street. Can't see the point of today either.

fog.head: Low-budget horror movie out.
fog.sub: Visibility {vis}. If you hear a chainsaw, go home.

fog.head: Fog thicker than your excuses.
fog.sub: Leave early. Drive like a grandparent.

fog.head: Can't see shit, part two.
fog.sub: Seriously, slow down. The fog doesn't care about your schedule.

windy.head: It's windy as hell.
windy.sub: Gusts up to {gusts}. Secure your hat, your bins and your dignity.

windy.head: Hold onto your shit.
windy.sub: Wind is {wind}. Umbrellas will die today.

windy.head: Free hairstyling outside.
windy.sub: Gusts of {gusts}. You won't like the style.

windy.head: Bad hair day guaranteed.
windy.sub: Gusts up to {gusts}. Don't bother styling anything.

windy.head: Trash cans are migrating.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Your recycling is touring the neighborhood.

windy.head: Blustery as fuck.
windy.sub: Hold onto your hat. Better yet, leave the hat at home.

windy.head: The air is shoving people.
windy.sub: Gusts of {gusts}. Walk into it like a determined little tugboat.

windy.head: Kite weather. Or chaos.
windy.sub: Depends on whether you're holding a kite or an umbrella.

windy.head: Doors will slam today.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Mind your fingers, you dumbass.

windy.head: Umbrella-flipping weather.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Your umbrella will turn inside out and so will your mood.

windy.head: Hair: destroyed.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Embrace the chaos or wear a hat with a strap.

scorching.head: It's fucking scorching.
scorching.sub: {temp} and it feels like {feels}. Sun's out, brain's cooked.

scorching.head: Satan called. He wants his weather back.
scorching.sub: Hydrate or die-drate. Stay in the shade.

scorching.head: Ow. The sun. Ow.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Your car is now an oven. Don't leave anything alive in it.

scorching.head: Hot as Satan's armpit.
scorching.sub: {temp}, feels like {feels}. Stay inside and worship your AC.

scorching.head: The air is soup.
scorching.sub: Hot soup. Don't touch metal. Don't touch anything.

scorching.head: Seatbelt buckle = branding iron.
scorching.sub: Your car has been preheating all day. {temp} outside, worse in there.

scorching.head: Nope. Absolutely not.
scorching.sub: {feels} feels-like. Water, shade, and zero cardio.

scorching.head: The sun chose violence.
scorching.sub: UV is {uv}. Sunscreen or become a lobster. Your call.

scorching.head: Sweating in places with no name.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Even your eyelids are hot. Stay in the shade.

scorching.head: Even the shade is hot.
scorching.sub: {temp}. There is no escape. Only AC.

scorching.head: Cooked. You will be cooked.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Pretend you're a vampire and stay in.

hot.head: It's hot as balls.
hot.sub: {temp} out there. Sweat in places you forgot you had.

hot.head: Toasty as hell.
hot.sub: Sunscreen. Water. Don't be a hero.

hot.head: Sweaty. Sticky. Gross.
hot.sub: Thighs will stick to every chair today. Plan accordingly.

hot.head: Sticky as hell.
hot.sub: {temp}. You'll be damp by noon and nobody will hug you.

hot.head: Pit stain o'clock.
hot.sub: Wear a dark shirt. Trust me.

hot.head: Toasty. Too toasty.
hot.sub: High of {high}. Ice cream is technically hydration.

hot.head: Swamp ass season.
hot.sub: Breathable fabrics. Breathable everything. You know why.

hot.head: The AC is your best friend now.
hot.sub: {temp}. Be nice to it. Close the damn door.

hot.head: Thigh-sweat season.
hot.sub: {temp}. Shorts are a necessity, not a choice.

hot.head: Hot enough to complain about.
hot.sub: High of {high}. You'll complain. Everyone will. Deal with it.

hot.head: Sun's out, everything's sticky.
hot.sub: Bring water and a backup shirt.

freezing.head: It's fucking freezing.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Your nostrils may freeze shut. Enjoy.

freezing.head: Cold as a witch's… everything.
freezing.sub: Below zero. Layers, gloves, hat. All of it.

freezing.head: Nope. Nope. Nope.
freezing.sub: It's {temp}. Stay under the blanket, it's the law now.

freezing.head: Ice cold. Like your ex.
freezing.sub: Watch for black ice. Walk like a penguin. It works.

freezing.head: Colder than your mother-in-law.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Your face will hurt. That's normal now.

freezing.head: Fuck. That. Cold.
freezing.sub: {temp}. Your car will take 10 minutes to stop screaming.

freezing.head: Ice everywhere.
freezing.sub: Every step is a gamble. Walk like you've got secrets in your pockets.

freezing.head: Snot icicle weather.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Cover your face. All of it.

freezing.head: Brass monkey territory.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. Pipes are scared. So am I.

freezing.head: Your eyeballs are cold.
freezing.sub: Didn't know that was possible? Welcome to {temp}.

freezing.head: Cold as hell. Frozen hell.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Every breath stings. Cute, right?

freezing.head: Lips: chapped. Soul: chapped.
freezing.sub: {temp}. Lip balm and layers, you beautiful icicle.

freezing.head: Arctic as fuck.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. Nobody should be outside. Including you.

cold.head: It's fucking cold.
cold.sub: Feels like {feels}. Grab a jacket, you stubborn ass.

cold.head: Brisk. That means cold.
cold.sub: Hoodie weather if you're tough. Jacket if you're smart.

cold.head: Chilly as shit.
cold.sub: High of {high}. That's it. That's the best it gets today.

cold.head: Hoodie won't cut it.
cold.sub: {temp} and feels like {feels}. Real jacket, tough guy.

cold.head: Nippy as hell.
cold.sub: Your nose will be red. Your hands will be sad. Gloves.

cold.head: Sweater weather, but meaner.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Hot drink in one hand, regret in the other.

cold.head: Cold enough to complain.
cold.sub: And you will. All day. To everyone.

cold.head: Heated seat weather.
cold.sub: If your car doesn't have them, I'm sorry. Truly. {temp}.

cold.head: Cold. Like, actually cold.
cold.sub: {temp}. Not 'brisk.' Not 'crisp.' Cold. Dress for it.

cold.head: Your fingers will hate you.
cold.sub: Feels like {feels}. Gloves exist for a reason.

cold.head: Soup weather.
cold.sub: {temp}. Make soup. Eat soup. Become soup.

cold.head: Hot coffee is mandatory.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Hold it with both hands like a little gremlin.

nice.head: It's actually fucking nice.
nice.sub: {temp} and pleasant. Go outside before it changes its mind.

nice.head: Holy shit, it's perfect.
nice.sub: No excuses today. Touch some grass.

nice.head: Nice. Suspiciously nice.
nice.sub: Enjoy it. Something will go wrong tomorrow. It always does.

nice.head: Damn, look at that.
nice.sub: Peak weather. If you stay inside today, that's on you.

nice.head: No complaints. Weird.
nice.sub: {temp}, clear and calm. I have nothing mean to say. I hate it.

nice.head: Goddamn gorgeous out.
nice.sub: Open a window. Better yet, walk through a door.

nice.head: Big touch-grass energy.
nice.sub: {temp}. The grass is right there. Touch it.

nice.head: The weather is carrying today.
nice.sub: If today sucks, that's on you, not the sky.

nice.head: Chef's kiss, honestly.
nice.sub: Go eat lunch outside like a person in a commercial.

nice.head: Holy hell, it's lovely.
nice.sub: {temp}. Somebody's having a great day. Make it you.

nice.head: Picnic weather, damn it.
nice.sub: Grab a blanket and some snacks. No excuses.

nice.head: Okay, sky. You win today.
nice.sub: {temp} and perfect. I take back everything I said yesterday.

meh.head: It's fucking meh.
meh.sub: Gray and boring. Like a Tuesday that won't end.

meh.head: Weather: unremarkable.
meh.sub: {temp}, cloudy, zero personality. Like a beige wall.

meh.head: The sky gave up.
meh.sub: Overcast and lifeless. Light jacket, low expectations.

meh.head: Gray. Just gray.
meh.sub: Nothing happening up there. Go do something interesting yourself.

meh.head: Aggressively beige.
meh.sub: {temp} and gray. The sky has the personality of a waiting room.

meh.head: Neither here nor there.
meh.sub: Not cold, not warm, not anything. Bring a light layer and lower your expectations.

meh.head: Blah. Just blah.
meh.sub: Perfect weather for doing laundry and questioning your choices.

meh.head: The sky is on mute.
meh.sub: Overcast and {temp}. Nothing to report, and that's the report.

meh.head: Sweatpants weather.
meh.sub: Gray, dull, cozy. Nobody's going to see you anyway.

meh.head: Peak mid.
meh.sub: The weather equivalent of a sandwich with no sauce.

meh.head: Gray. Again. Shit.
meh.sub: {temp}. The sky is giving Monday energy no matter what day it is.

meh.head: Uninspired weather.
meh.sub: Not good enough to go out, not bad enough to complain. Limbo.

clearNight.head: It's a nice fucking night.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies, {temp}. Look up, you might see a star or a satellite.

clearNight.head: Go to bed.
clearNight.sub: It's dark and clear and you're on your phone checking the weather.

clearNight.head: Clear skies. Starry as hell.
clearNight.sub: Good night for a walk. Or for staring at the ceiling.

clearNight.head: Stars are out. Are you?
clearNight.sub: Clear and {temp}. Go look up for a minute, it's free.

clearNight.head: Quiet as hell out there.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies, {temp}. Perfect night for bad decisions or good sleep.

clearNight.head: Moon's doing its thing.
clearNight.sub: Clear night, low of {low}. Close the laptop.

clearNight.head: Night mode: activated.
clearNight.sub: It's dark, it's clear, and you're still checking the weather. Bed.

clearNight.head: Clear skies. Bad sleep anyway.
clearNight.sub: {temp}. Put the phone face down and close your eyes.

clearNight.head: Good night for a walk.
clearNight.sub: Clear and {temp}. Bring a light layer and some sense.

clearNight.head: Starry as hell.
clearNight.sub: Get away from the streetlights and look up. Worth it.

clearNight.head: The night is clear. Your mind isn't.
clearNight.sub: Turn off the screen. Seriously. It's late.
